note: Gate timings measured on the sha3d gate engine (js/live/gate_system.js, Oshkosh AeroTech sell-sheet rates, inf placeholder: the bridge make at ZSSS is unknown) in node with the WebGL stub, each stand x type alone (every other stand empty). The sim schedules with these numbers (design §1.5); the page re-measures sampled stands at boot and only logs a difference.

basis.dock_s: dock call (setOccupant with the arrival, animated) -> docked: DOCK_DELAY 12 s + the docking path at the sheet rates; 22 s fallback animation where no bridge docks the type (dockN 0)
basis.undock_s: undockEarly from docked -> every bridge at rest: the levelled retraction at the sheet rates (16 s fallback where no bridge docks)
basis.hurry_s: undockEta from docked: the retraction at the sheet maximum rates (hurryPlans(undockPlans(g), 1).T)
basis.pushClear_s: pushClearEta from docked: every bridge clear of the straight push-back sweep (pushHitK) at the maximum rates
basis.rounding: each value rounded up to 0.1 s
basis.pose: the type parked by the stop convention: nose wheel on the stand stop node (gate_system.js standTip), stand heading; 238A / 259A on the base stand bridges with their own pose
basis.fit: the engine accepted types (span <= stand max + 0.6 m, length <= max + 2 m) plus the drawn model of each stand-in type whose own span and length fit (sha_sim_inputs params.standIns)

rules.undockLead: max(150 s, undock_s + 15 s) before off-block
